summary: Blacklisted the usb-storage kernel module on node1 (blacklist + install /bin/false directive in /etc/modprobe.d/usb-storage-blacklist.conf), rebuilt initramfs with dracut so the block persists across boot, then performed the mandatory single-node reboot to prove persistence: boot_id changed from 19062a82... to 8e2a8b8d..., and post-reboot the module remains unloaded and modprobe still refuses to load it.
actions_performed: Checked baseline: usb-storage not loaded, no existing blacklist entry
Ran dracut -f to rebuild initramfs including the new modprobe.d config
Verified live modprobe usb-storage now fails (blocked)
Verified initramfs (lsinitrd) contains the new blacklist file
Captured pre-reboot baseline boot_id and system health
Issued systemctl reboot on node1 (single node, none else touched)
Polled node1 until exec connectivity returned
Verified new boot_id differs from baseline, confirming real reboot
Re-verified usb_storage still unloaded and modprobe still blocked post-reboot

evidence.requirement: usb-storage not currently loaded / no prior blacklist
evidence.summary: lsmod shows usb_storage absent; /etc/modprobe.d has no usb-storage entry before change
Wrote /etc/modprobe.d/usb-storage-blacklist.conf with blacklist and install /bin/false directives, ran dracut -f to rebuild initramfs

evidence.requirement: Module load blocked live and blacklist present in initramfs (persists across reboot)
evidence.summary: modprobe usb-storage fails with exit 1 (install command /bin/false), and lsinitrd confirms usb-storage-blacklist.conf is included in the rebuilt initramfs
Captured boot_id 19062a82-6390-435d-a09f-4dba1593d529, systemctl is-system-running=running, usb_storage confirmed not loaded
systemctl reboot issued in background; exec stream closed as node went down, confirming reboot was triggered
Repeated polling shows connection timeouts/resets during reboot, then successful command execution once node1 came back online

evidence.requirement: Changed boot identity and post-restart recovery of required state (module still blocked, no data loss)
evidence.summary: New boot_id 8e2a8b8d-6c9e-4662-bb3a-928c7a77f5e1 differs from baseline, system running, usb_storage still not loaded, modprobe usb-storage still fails, and the blacklist config file content persisted unchanged
